protocols.protocol.txt:
Independent fixed-geometry coupled reference for the last relaxation phase of the saved contact-metric Rain probe. Include all39active joints and41active contact manifolds; prepared step-start inertia, final joint geometry, prepared contact levers and reconstruction of delta poses. Preserve original spring softness, targets, speculative biases, motor caps, and contact friction/rolling/twist bounds dependent on current normal impulses. Symmetrize captured tiny inertia asymmetries explicitly. This is a float64 reconstructed linearized subproblem, not a new physics trajectory or GPU qualification.
Use a natural-map complementarity residual with scalar block preconditioning (largest local effective-mass eigenvalue), Euclidean domain projections and analytic generalized Jacobian. These projections define metric-correct KKT stationarity; do not replace original physical coefficients. Solve the complete residual with SciPy Levenberg-Marquardt, at most120function evaluations; record unsuccessful termination and do not raise work budget after seeing results. Before solving, require24directional Jacobian finite-difference controls with relative error<1e-5 and recorded prepared contact mass consistency.
Reference success requires maximum relative natural-map residual<=1e-8, original domain feasibility within1e-8scaled, direct primal-versus-assembled residual agreement<=1e-9scaled, and a complete sequential metric block sweep changes every velocity/cache by<=1e-5relative. Report all residuals even when unsuccessful. Compare the saved capped state with reference, but do not infer physical Rain acceptance or speed from this CPU calculation. Identify network conditioning or dominant residuals to guide a later GPU-native candidate; no cap sweep, no production source change.
protocols.structured-protocol.txt:
Follow-up to failed generic LM solve (not a higher LM work budget). Same reconstructed full equations and original acceptance checks. Solve the convex quadratic impulse problem at fixed contact friction/rolling/twist bounds using Clarabel with original Hessian/softness and all original motor domains; update contact bounds from its normal impulses through a reduced56variable nonlinear fixed point. Do NOT jointly optimize friction cone and normal force in one associated-friction cone problem, which would change the normal KKT equations.
Clarabel max100iterations, gap/feasibility tolerances1e-12, ktratio1e-10, one thread; preserve solver status and independently record fixed-bound natural residual. Outer SciPy Anderson uses memory5, default regularization, Armijo search, max32iterations, absolute normal fixed-point tolerance1e-9 and an additional hard128QP-call budget. Stop on unsuccessful inner status or budget; no parameter retries after seeing results. Final acceptance remains full normalized natural residual<=1e-8, scaled domain feasibility<=1e-8, direct primal agreement<=1e-9 and full metric sweep velocity/cache changes<=1e-5. Preserve generic LM failure and every outer-call receipt. This is reference mathematics, not physical Rain or GPU qualification.
protocols.polish-protocol.txt:
The structured normal-bound reference stopped at its unchanged32outer-iteration limit; retain that failed result. It reduced full natural residual from1.75e-3 to7.82e-6, but feasibility and complete-sweep checks still fail. Fixed-bound solves reach2.8e-9 to1.7e-6 residual, so the outer method alone is not a high-accuracy root certificate.
Test a finite hybrid reference: apply at most8semismooth Newton corrections to the preserved best structured state, using the original full734variable natural residual and analytic Jacobian. Use SVD minimum-norm correction with fixed rcond1e-12 to discard numerical null modes. Require merit decrease by Armijo1e-4 with at most8half-step backtracks. Record each residual, effective rank, linear solve residual and accepted step; stop if no step succeeds. No change to original acceptance thresholds or either failed solver receipt. This is an active-set refinement, not extra iterations of the frozen GPU wave or outer bound solver. It is still only a float64 fixed-geometry reference, not a production algorithm or physical pass.
protocols.acceleration-protocol.txt:
Test a GPU-oriented projected Anderson acceleration of complete native-order waves in the reconstructed fixed-geometry relaxation problem. Use captured color order, original joint row order, paired normal blocks with existing singular fallback, and original convex/mesh friction ordering. Preserve original model coefficients, softness, motor bounds and current normal-dependent friction bounds. Matrix algebra is float64; no bit-exact or physical trajectory claim.
Compare plain waves and accelerated waves from two predeclared impulse starts: all-zero caches with consistent affine body velocities, and saved capped caches. Each arm has a hard128complete-wave evaluation budget, including rejected acceleration proposals. Anderson uses at most4previous differences, minimum-norm weighted least squares with rcond1e-10, weights sqrt(local effective-mass diagonal). Project proposals onto original domains, then reconstruct consistent velocities through the fixed Jacobian; do not independently blend velocities and caches. At most one proposal per accepted state; accept only if its maximum per-row velocity/cache change is<=0.9times current wave residual, otherwise fall back to the plain wave. No parameter tuning after results.
Require two consecutive quiet complete waves with both velocity/cache relative changes<=1e-5 AND full relative natural residual<=1e-8 at finish; compare to the independently converged reference. This experiment starts from reconstructed cold/capped states, not captured actual phase entry, and cannot qualify all8GPU phases. It decides whether this acceleration merits a later actual-phase GPU prototype. Preserve all failed arms and work counts.

import model as m
import numpy as np,json,time,scipy
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
p=m.p;rng=np.random.default_rng(20260930);checks=[]
for i in range(24):
 x=m.old+.03*rng.normal(size=m.offset);direction=rng.normal(size=m.offset);direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction);eps=1e-6
 fd=(m.residual(x+eps*direction)-m.residual(x-eps*direction))/(2*eps);analytic=m.residual(x,True)@direction;error=float(np.max(abs(fd-analytic)/(1+abs(analytic))));checks.append(error)
control=dict(cases=len(checks),errors=checks,max_error=max(checks),limit=1e-5,passed=max(checks)<1e-5)
(p/'jacobian-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(control,indent=2));assert control['passed'];print('Jacobian controls:',control['max_error'],flush=True)
(p/'model-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(m.metadata,indent=2));assert m.metadata['maximum_prepared_normal_mass_identity_error']<1e-5 and m.metadata['maximum_prepared_tangent_mass_identity_error']<1e-5
initial=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(m.old))/(1+abs(m.old))));initial_sweep,_=m.sweep(m.old);print('Initial relative natural residual:',initial,'sweep:',initial_sweep,flush=True)
start=time.monotonic();result=least_squares(m.residual,m.old,jac=lambda x:m.residual(x,True),method='lm',max_nfev=120,ftol=1e-12,xtol=1e-12,gtol=1e-12);elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
x=result.x;grad=m.gradient_primal(x);dense=m.H@x+m.g;agreement=float(np.max(abs(grad-dense)/(1+np.maximum(abs(grad),abs(dense)))));natural=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(x))/(1+abs(x))));sweep,_=m.sweep(x);feas=[];ranking=[]
for b in m.blocks:
 sl=b['sl'];val=x[sl];domain=b['domain'];radius=m.radius(b,x);violation=0.
 if domain=='positive':violation=float(max(0,-min(val)))
 elif domain=='box':violation=float(max(0,max(abs(val))-radius)/(1+radius))
 elif domain=='ball':violation=float(max(0,np.linalg.norm(val)-radius)/(1+radius))
 feas.append(violation);ranking.append(dict(label=b['label'],relative_natural_residual=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(x)[sl])/(1+abs(val)))),feasibility_violation=violation))
passed=bool(natural<=1e-8 and max(feas)<=1e-8 and agreement<=1e-9 and max(sweep['max_velocity_change'],sweep['max_impulse_change'])<=1e-5)
output=dict(status='reference-residual-pass' if passed else 'reference-residual-failed',scope=m.metadata['scope'],metadata=m.metadata,scipy_version=scipy.__version__,numpy_version=np.__version__,solver='scipy.optimize.least_squares LM, max_nfev120',solver_termination=dict(success=bool(result.success),status=int(result.status),message=result.message,nfev=result.nfev,njev=result.njev,cost=float(result.cost),optimality=float(result.optimality),elapsed_seconds=elapsed),initial_relative_natural_residual=initial,initial_sweep=initial_sweep,final_relative_natural_residual=natural,direct_primal_residual_agreement=agreement,maximum_scaled_feasibility_violation=max(feas),final_sweep=sweep,velocity_change_from_capped=float(np.max(abs(m.M@m.J.T@(x-m.old)))),impulse_change_from_capped=float(np.max(abs(x-m.old))),maximum_absolute_impulse=float(np.max(abs(x))),worst_residual_blocks=sorted(ranking,key=lambda r:r['relative_natural_residual'],reverse=True)[:12])
np.savez(p/'solution.npz',impulses=x,capped_impulses=m.old,velocities=m.vfree+m.M@m.J.T@x,capped_velocities=m.vcap)
(p/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2));print(json.dumps(output,indent=2),flush=True)
if not passed:raise SystemExit(1)

import model as m
import numpy as np,json,time
p=m.p;x=np.load(p/'structured-solution.npz')['impulses'];records=[];start=time.monotonic();termination='eight-step-cap'
for iteration in range(8):
 r=m.residual(x);natural=float(np.max(abs(r)/(1+abs(x))))
 if natural<=1e-10:termination='strict-natural-residual';break
 D=m.residual(x,True);dx,_,rank,s=np.linalg.lstsq(D,-r,rcond=1e-12);linear=float(np.max(abs(D@dx+r)));merit=float(r@r);accepted=False
 for backtrack in range(8):
  alpha=2.**-backtrack;trial=x+alpha*dx;rt=m.residual(trial)
  if rt@rt<=(1-1e-4*alpha)*merit:accepted=True;break
 row=dict(iteration=iteration+1,initial_relative_natural_residual=natural,rank=int(rank),minimum_singular=float(s[-1]),maximum_singular=float(s[0]),linear_residual=linear,accepted=accepted,step=alpha if accepted else 0.,backtracks=backtrack)
 records.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 if not accepted:termination='line-search-failed';break
 x=trial
natural=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(x))/(1+abs(x))));grad=m.gradient_primal(x);dense=m.H@x+m.g;agreement=float(np.max(abs(grad-dense)/(1+np.maximum(abs(grad),abs(dense)))));sweep,_=m.sweep(x);feas=[]
for b in m.blocks:
 val=x[b['sl']];domain=b['domain'];r=m.radius(b,x);error=0.
 if domain=='positive':error=max(0,-float(min(val)))
 elif domain=='box':error=max(0,float(max(abs(val)))-r)/(1+r)
 elif domain=='ball':error=max(0,float(np.linalg.norm(val))-r)/(1+r)
 feas.append(error)
passed=bool(natural<=1e-8 and max(feas)<=1e-8 and agreement<=1e-9 and max(sweep['max_velocity_change'],sweep['max_impulse_change'])<=1e-5)
result=dict(status='reference-residual-pass' if passed else 'reference-residual-failed',scope=m.metadata['scope'],termination=termination,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,iterations=records,final_relative_natural_residual=natural,maximum_scaled_feasibility_violation=max(feas),direct_primal_residual_agreement=agreement,final_sweep=sweep,velocity_change_from_capped=float(np.max(abs(m.M@m.J.T@(x-m.old)))),impulse_change_from_capped=float(np.max(abs(x-m.old))),maximum_absolute_impulse=float(np.max(abs(x))))
np.savez(p/'polished-solution.npz',impulses=x,capped_impulses=m.old,velocities=m.vfree+m.M@m.J.T@x,capped_velocities=m.vcap);(p/'polished-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
if not passed:raise SystemExit(1)

import model as m
from wave import wave,project,ops
import numpy as np,json,time
p=m.p;weights=np.sqrt(np.diag(m.J@m.M@m.J.T));reference=np.load(p/'polished-solution.npz');all_results={};start=time.monotonic()
for initial_name,initial in [('cold',np.zeros(m.offset)),('capped',m.old)]:
 for accelerated in [False,True]:
  label=initial_name+('-anderson' if accelerated else '-plain');x=project(initial);history=[];records=[];calls=0;cached=None;quiet=0;accepted=0;rejected=0;terminal=False;last={}
  def evaluate(x,kind):
   global calls
   y,stats=wave(x);calls+=1;records.append(dict(call=calls,kind=kind,**stats));return y,stats
  while calls<128 or cached is not None:
   if cached is not None:y,stats=cached;cached=None
   else:y,stats=evaluate(x,'plain')
   last=stats;merit=max(stats['max_velocity_change'],stats['max_impulse_change']);r=y-x
   quiet=quiet+1 if merit<=1e-5 else 0
   if quiet>=2 and np.max(abs(m.residual(x))/(1+abs(x)))<=1e-8:terminal=True;break
   history.append((x.copy(),r.copy()));history=history[-5:]
   if accelerated and len(history)>=2 and calls<128 and quiet==0:
    DX=np.column_stack([history[i+1][0]-history[i][0] for i in range(len(history)-1)]);DR=np.column_stack([history[i+1][1]-history[i][1] for i in range(len(history)-1)]);gamma=np.linalg.lstsq(weights[:,None]*DR,weights*r,rcond=1e-10)[0];proposal=project(y-(DX+DR)@gamma);py,pstats=evaluate(proposal,'proposal')
    pmerit=max(pstats['max_velocity_change'],pstats['max_impulse_change'])
    if pmerit<=.9*merit:accepted+=1;x=proposal;cached=(py,pstats);continue
    rejected+=1
   x=y
   if calls>=128:break
  natural=float(np.max(abs(m.residual(x))/(1+abs(x))));result=dict(status='pass' if terminal else 'work-cap-failed',complete_wave_evaluations=calls,accepted_proposals=accepted,rejected_proposals=rejected,final_relative_natural_residual=natural,last_evaluated_sweep=last,reference_velocity_max_difference=float(np.max(abs(m.vfree+m.M@m.J.T@x-reference['velocities']))),reference_impulse_max_difference=float(np.max(abs(x-reference['impulses']))),records=records)
  all_results[label]=result;np.savez(p/(label+'-acceleration-state.npz'),impulses=x);(p/'acceleration-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope='Float64 fixed-geometry prototype; captured color and row order, not original phase-entry states or bit-exact shader execution.',operations_per_wave=len(ops),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,arms=all_results),indent=2));print(label,json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='records'}),flush=True)
if not all(all_results[k]['status']=='pass' for k in ['cold-anderson','capped-anderson']):raise SystemExit(1)
